name: Ley line
slug: Lines of magic that gatehouses sit on
description: Ley lines are lines of magic that gatehouses sit on.

log.summary: Carlkin says a keystone portal opened away from a gatehouse would need a powerful crossing of ley lines. The party has tried to do this and, apart from Gerk's doors, has not succeeded.
notes: Lines of magic that gatehouses sit on. Carlkin says a keystone portal opened away from a gatehouse would need a powerful crossing of them. The party has tried and, apart from Gerk's doors, has not succeeded.

log.summary: Elrus describes a ley line as a magical boundary that crisscrosses the world, a concentration of the Weave formed over eons. Some say Atlas’s rotation created them; others compare them to magical latitude and longitude. Walker had not been taught this. An old obsidian marker at Monkey Falls marks an intersection that would have been a highly magical site. Markers shift over millennia and have been moved or hidden because mages fought over them. Spells cast on a line are bolstered, including teleportation for less energy. They are not a tunnel network between planes. The casting point must be within feet of a convergence, which is rare. Grixto’s rotated carvings point at one that moved, and Elrus considers it worth visiting.
